1258 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
09-09-1258 minus 324 days:  
Back up 9 days → 1258-08-31.  
Back up 31 days → 1258-07-31.  
Continue: June 30 days, May 31, April 30, March 31, February 28, January 31.  
Total days subtracted: 9+31+31+30+31+30+31+28+31 = 252 days so far (to 1258-01-09).  
Need 324 total: 324 − 252 = 72 more days back into 1257.  
December 31 days, November 30 days → 31+30=61 days, to 1257-11-01.  
Remaining 72−61=11 days back from 1257-11-01 → 1257-10-21.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1257-10-21
